policy.duplicateNutritionNames: Duplicate-name targets attach shared nutrition only when every candidate has the same serving size and identical nutrition; all candidate source IDs remain in provenance.
policy.missingNutrition: The restaurant artifact omits nutrition when neither official source resolves safely, and never copies historical production nutrition.

schemaLimitations: Unresolved non-contextual leaf records still omit nutrition even though the production MenuItem and IngredientItem types require it.
The production schema cannot represent arbitrary nested source choice groups, contextual min/max rules, modifier pricing, or all source IDs directly.
The full source graph is retained in restaurant.json.sourceRelationships; the generated artifact must not replace production data while unresolved nutrition remains.
